meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 碰到 Git 相关任务时,Claude 会先检查仓库现状,再帮你提交代码、整理提交记录,或追查某处改动是谁、何时做的;改动前会先做安全检查,并给出有证据的结论。你不主动要求,它不会改动任何提交记录。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、整理提交记录,或询问某行代码是谁写的、何时加的时,它会接管。普通改代码不触发,除非你明确提到 Git。

say.text: 把我这些改动拆成几个逻辑提交,每个提交单独一个功能。
say.note: 它会先检查改动再按功能分组提交。

say.text: 看看这几行代码是谁写的、什么时候加的。
say.note: 它会用历史追查命令查证并回报证据。

say.text: 帮我把最近这三个提交合并成一个。
say.note: 它会用 rebase 合并,冲突时先问你。

howto.what_en: For Git history tasks, Claude checks the repository first, then commits, rewrites, or traces changes by the rules. It verifies safety before writes and returns evidence-backed answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit code, rewrite or tidy up commit history, or ask who wrote a line or when it was added. Plain code edits won't trigger it unless you explicitly ask for Git work.

say_en.text: Split my changes into logical commits, one feature per commit.
say_en.note: It checks changes first, then groups them by feature.

say_en.text: Check who wrote these lines and when they were added.
say_en.note: It traces history with git tools and reports the evidence.

say_en.text: Merge the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: It merges via rebase and asks you before resolving conflicts.
